google_map_address_grounding.syntax_description: Paste a real Google Maps US street address into the prompt to generate an environment modeled after real street view locations.
google_map_address_grounding.supported_regions: US street view locations only (Miami, Los Angeles, New York, etc.)
google_map_address_grounding.korean_template: [구글맵 미국 주소 입력], [시간대 및 날씨], [장소 분위기: 예. 활기찬 마이애미 해변가, 네온 사인이 켜진 다운타운], [카메라 화각: 와이드 샷 / 스트리트 뷰 시점]
google_map_address_grounding.english_template: Street level photograph at [Exact US Google Maps Address], [Time of day: golden hour / night], [Atmosphere / aesthetic: GTA 6 Vice City photorealism, humid palm-lined avenue], [Camera angle: 35mm lens, street level wide view], cinematic lighting
google_map_address_grounding.example: Street level photograph at 1001 Ocean Dr, Miami Beach, FL 33139, late afternoon golden hour, GTA 6 Vice City aesthetic, photorealistic detail, neon signs beginning to glow, palm trees swaying, ultra high resolution

workflow_steps: 1. Generate or upload base character image
3. Click 'Add from project' and select the base image
4. Assign Name, Voice profile, and Personality description
5. The character is saved in Flow's registry and can be attached to any future prompt by name

storyboard_grid.korean_template: @[캐릭터이름], [구글맵 주소 또는 배경], [스토리 시나리오 설명]. 3x3 스토리보드 그리드 이미지, 9개의 연속된 컷, 영화 같은 샷 구성, 캐릭터의 얼굴과 의상 일관성 유지, 높은 디테일
storyboard_grid.english_template: A 3x3 storyboard contact sheet grid featuring @[CharacterName] at [Location / Google Maps Address]. 9 sequential panels showing: [Panel 1-3: Setup], [Panel 4-6: Conflict/Action], [Panel 7-9: Climax/Resolution]. Cinematic film still, consistent character face and clothing across all panels, detailed environments, high realism
storyboard_grid.example: A 3x3 storyboard contact sheet grid featuring Jason at 1001 Ocean Dr, Miami Beach. 9 sequential action panels showing Jason spotting an unmarked car, sprinting through an alley, jumping over a fence, and escaping on a speedboat. Consistent character face, white tank top and jeans, intense cinematic film stills, sharp photorealistic details

grid_to_video.target_model: Veo 3.1 - Lite [Lower Priority] (0 credits) or Gemini Omni / Veo Fast
prompt_structure: 1. Attach the Storyboard Grid Image + Character in prompt ingredients
2. Character action description (what character physically does from first to last beat)
3. Camera movement direction (tracking shot, slow dolly-in, continuous pan)
4. Atmospheric & audio cues (ambient city sounds, engine revving)
grid_to_video.english_template: Cinematic 10-second video following @[CharacterName] based on the attached storyboard grid. The camera starts with a tight tracking shot as the character starts running, smoothly transitioning into a wide dolly-out revealing the Miami boulevard. Smooth cinematic motion, continuous action, 720p 24fps
grid_to_video.korean_template: 첨부된 스토리보드 그리드를 기반으로 한 10초 분량의 시네마틱 영상. 캐릭터가 첫 프레임의 위치에서 출발하여 질주하는 모습을 부드러운 트래킹 카메라로 따라감. 영화 같은 카메라 워크, 자연스러운 연속 동작, 고화질 렌더링
